title: gagea arvensis
intro: Gagea arvensis, commonly known as the wood lily or wild lily, is a flowering plant species in the lily family (Liliaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic actions, aiding in wound healing and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Gagea arvensis include its use as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
